methodologyNotes: Prices fetched from official vendor pricing/product pages where available. Bark prices from bark.us/pricing and bark.us/bark-app (USD prices rendered live, June 2026). Qustodio's official site (qustodio.com/en/premium/) geolocated to EUR; USD plan prices sourced from TechRadar review (last updated July 2025) and cross-checked against TechRadar review article for plan structure — noted in provenance. Norton Family from us.norton.com/products/norton-family-premier (USD prices live). Aura from aura.com/pricing and aura.com/parental-controls (USD prices live). Mobicip from mobicip.com/pricing (USD prices live, billed annually). CleanBrowsing from cleanbrowsing.org/pricing (USD prices live). Circle (meetcircle.com) now redirects to Aura — Circle is excluded as a separate entity since it merged into Aura. All monthlyUsd figures for annually-billed plans represent the annualized monthly rate. accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources.

vendors.name: Bark
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page bark.us/pricing and product page bark.us/bark-app fetched 2026-06-14; USD prices rendered live.

plans.name: Bark Jr
plans.notes: Annual price $49/yr ($4.08/mo). Covers unlimited devices and children. Includes screen time management, website filtering, location alerts/check-ins, and basic monitoring of texts/email/30+ apps. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Bark Premium (Android)
plans.notes: Annual price $99/yr ($8.25/mo). Covers unlimited devices and children. Full monitoring of texts, email, YouTube, and 30+ social/app platforms; AI-driven alerts for cyberbullying, predators, and mental health concerns; GPS tracking; screen time; app/website blocking. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Bark Premium (iOS)
plans.notes: Annual price $148/yr ($12.33/mo). Higher price includes the Bark Sync smart charger hardware (required due to Apple privacy restrictions — device must be plugged in to scan). Same monitoring features as Android Premium. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Bark Home
plans.notes: Router-based home network parental controls. $6/mo subscription OR $79 one-time device purchase (no monthly fee). Covers all home devices (smart TVs, gaming consoles, tablets, computers). 30-day money-back guarantee.

limits: Available only in US, South Africa, and Australia
iOS monitoring requires Bark Sync smart charger hardware (sold separately or bundled with iOS plan)

plans.notes: Monthly: $15/mo. Annual: $150/yr ($12.50/mo), ~17% discount. Up to 50 devices, up to 7.5M DNS requests/month. 5 filtering profiles. Targeted at schools and libraries.
